title: Residual: diameter-2 remainder outside PC+ and BS4
statement_en: Every graph in the class of conj_kelly_ulam__connected_dominating_or_diam2__diam2_impure__no_half_pure_no_two_card__no_pointed_pair_no_switch__no_triple_window that is in neither slice_determined (PC+) nor aligned_switch_kelly4 (BS4) is reconstructible: such a graph has a phantom at every vertex pair and a labelled 4-mate. Open; no member known.
